latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of agent-state-backup.
- Provides daily automatic backup for core agent files (IDENTITY, SOUL, MEMORY, knowledge base) via cron.
- Backs up files as compressed .tgz archives and retains the latest 7 backups by default.
- Includes scripts for one-click manual backup and restore.
- Enables easy migration or recovery to prevent context loss after restarts or environment changes.
